media.alt: Graphical Lines menu showing line, arrow, and inhibition presets beside a sample workflow.
media.caption: Choose a line or arrow by its shape. Draw new places it on the canvas; Apply to selected restyles an eligible selected line.
media.intent: Show the current graphical Lines menu beside editable sample-preparation and imaging shapes.

media.alt: Choose the straight arrow preset and drag between two sample-workflow shapes.
media.caption: Choose Lines → Arrows → Straight, then drag from the start point to the end point.
media.intent: Show a researcher choosing the straight arrow preset, then dragging once to draw an editable arrow between two example steps.
steps: Open Lines and choose Draw new.
Drag between the two shapes, then release.

media.alt: An unselected arrow endpoint is found by a Direct Selection marquee and moved upward.
media.caption: In Advanced, use Direct Selection (A). Drag a box around an endpoint, then drag the selected endpoint. The other endpoint stays fixed.
media.intent: Show Direct Selection discovering an unselected arrow endpoint with a marquee and moving only that endpoint.
steps: Drag a selection box around the unselected endpoint.
Drag the selected endpoint to change the arrow.

media.alt: Editable assay workflow with Prepare samples, Acquire images, and Compare conditions connected by arrows.
media.caption: Build a diagram from editable shapes and text, then connect the steps with arrows.
media.intent: Show a complete assay-workflow example with editable native shapes, text, and arrows.

media.caption: Browser saves stay on this device. Download file makes a portable copy; Saved work shows documents stored in this browser. Appearance stays visible in the header.
